table.name: Friend
table.purpose: Friendship pairs between high school students: each row links a student to one of their friends (both referencing Highschooler).

friend_id.name: friend_id
friend_id.description: ID of the Highschooler who is the friend in the pair; references Highschooler.ID.

student_id.name: student_id
student_id.description: ID of the Highschooler who has this friend; references Highschooler.ID.

table.name: Highschooler
table.purpose: Master list of high school students, one row per student, with their name and grade.

grade.name: grade
grade.description: School grade level of the student, 9-12 (US high school freshman through senior).

name.name: name
name.description: Student's first name (some names repeat across different students).

table.name: Likes
table.purpose: Romantic-interest records: each row states that one high schooler likes another (references Highschooler on both sides).

liked_id.name: liked_id
liked_id.description: ID of the Highschooler who is liked; references Highschooler.ID.

student_id.name: student_id
student_id.description: ID of the Highschooler who likes the other student; references Highschooler.ID. Each student appears at most once as the liker.
